page0.text:
"Like hell I will! I'll admit that you're the superior mage. But you make mistakes sometimes, too.
I won't just turn a blind eye if you say something crazy. If I think you're wrong, I'll be sure to tell you. That's what it means to help each other."

page1.text:
"Naturally. We can't cooperate unless you do that.
I've been thinking that I get carried away sometimes, so I need someone to put the brakes on.
I'd appreciate it if you'd do that for me."

page2.text:
"Oh."
That's...a little anticlimactic.
I was ready for her to argue against me, but Tohsaka seems satisfied with my answer.

page3.text:
"Last question.
I'll do whatever I can to help you when there's something you can't do.
On the other hand, though...can you do the same for me?"

page4.text:
"Huh? Something I can do, that you can't?"
Does anything like that even exist?
Is Tohsaka actually bad at cooking, or something?

page5.text:
"Hey. This is the most important question, so answer fast. Yes or no?"
"...Um, could you give me a more specific example?"

page6.text: "Argh, come on! I'm asking if you'll let me win!"

page7.text:
...
Tohsaka blusters sulkily, her cheeks flushed.
It's a far cry from the image I've had of her so far, like that of a child.

page8.text:
And yet...
"...Yeah.
If we're going to work together, then I'll let you win. I promise."
...she's so sincere. I can't help but find it cute.

page9.text:
"Let's meet up at the front gate after school, then.
I'm going to have you do club activities at my house for the time being."
"Um. Club activities? At your house?"

page10.text:
"Yeah. Since we're teaming up, I should teach you to be able to fight on your own as much as I can, right?
...I already know you're an amateur since the other night, though, so we'll need to have you come over multiple days."

page11.text:
"I don't mind. I'd appreciate that, actually.
Um, are we starting today?"

page12.text:
"Obviously. We need to gauge your abilities first, then figure out how to proceed from tonight.
You'll be getting home pretty late, but that's fine since you live alone anyway, right?"
"Huh? Yeah, but how did you know that?"

page13.text:
"! W-well, when I gave you first aid the other time, I just assumed because I didn't see anyone else at your house.
A-anyway, that's the plan, so wait for me out front!"

page14.text:
...
Tohsaka leaves with a casual wave.
Today's Friday. Classes run until sixth period, and we get out after 3:00 PM.

page15.text:
"...Oh, man. I told Sakura I'd come home early, but I can't just cancel on Tohsaka the very first day."
I'm sorry to Sakura who I'm taking care of at home, but I'll need to join Tohsaka today.
